# Loading libraries and importing data

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
source("99_project_functions.R")

GEP_genes <- c(
"CD27", "CD274", "PDCD1", "CD276", "CD8A", "CMKLR1",
"CXCL9", "CXCR6", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-E",
"IDO1", "LAG3", "NKG7", "PDCD1LG2", "PSMB10", "STAT1",
"TIGIT"
)

readRDS("../data/IMvigor210_plain.rds")
```

# Quantile normalization

```{r}
counts_df <- IMvigor210_plain$counts |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("gene")
quantile_normalized <- quantile_normalization(counts_df)
```

# Calculating GEP score

```{r}
metadata_with_GEP <- GEP_score_calculation(quantile_normalized,
                                           IMvigor210_plain$clinical,
                                           GEP_genes)
```

```{r}
write_csv(metadata_with_GEP, "../results/clinical_metadata_with_GEP.csv")
```

## Check which genes are present

```{r}
signature_genes <- tibble(
  GEP_gene = GEP_genes
)

quantile_normalized |>
  right_join(signature_genes,
             join_by(gene == GEP_gene)) |>
  pivot_longer(!gene,
               names_to = "pat_id",
               values_to = "expr") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(expr)) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  summarise(n = n())
```

No missing values for any of the genes in any of the samples
